column1: # Scenario matrix for the lending lifecycle suite. Edit freely - nothing here is hard-coded in the code.
#  scenarioId        unique id used in the audit trail and defect list
#  cohort            A = good borrower (must reach CLOSED)
#  weight            how many times the row is repeated in the round-robin that fills the account count; 0 disables the row
#  productCode       must exist and be ACTIVE (checked by dry-run). Mortgage products (HL01) are excluded: they need a mortgage record.
#  dayCount          API tokens: ACT_365 ACT_ACT ACT_360 THIRTY_360 THIRTY_E_360
#  observeDaysAfterLastDue  how long to keep simulating a stress account after its last scheduled due date
#  requiresFeatures  platform capabilities this scenario relies on; if a capability probe says NOT FOUND the scenario is reported as a gap
